journal.title: A new start
journal.excerpt: I spent most of a day cleaning up two old projects, giving them proper visuals, and building a homepage for bat-cat.net.
journal.body:
I spent most of a day cleaning up two old projects, one from high school and one from university, and building this homepage for bat-cat.net.

Both projects used to be code and nothing else. You had to read the source to understand what they did. Giving them a real interface changed that: the chess engine now has a board with cat pieces you can actually play on, and the 24-point solver became a card game in the browser. Seeing them on screen made them feel like finished things for the first time.

The homepage was the bigger job. I wanted one place where the three of us could keep our projects and the notes we write along the way, with Tangyuan and Niangao somewhere on the page too. Now it exists, and it's live.

It's a goal I've had for a long time, and today I finally got it done.

journal.body:
For my life sciences course, I made a small website about obesity instead of a written report. It covers what causes obesity, how it affects the body, and what the research says about preventing and treating it.
